associations.rationale: The type directly states that the scalar, skew, and traceless-symmetric subspaces form an internal direct sum in End(R3), which is the asserted decomposition.
The type directly supplies the one-dimensionality of the scalar summand in the stated decomposition.
The type directly supplies the asserted dimension three of the skew, standard summand.
The type directly supplies the asserted dimension five of the traceless-symmetric summand.
